column1: # THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE FORECAST AND THE OUTCOME
# The historical estimate was 2/3/5 named ACTs. The family
# consumed exactly 5 named ACTs: the parent, ONE technical
# correction and THREE governance corrections. The technical
# work was ONE ACT. The remaining THREE ACTs were spent on the
# FACTORY-V2 RANGE AND TERMINALITY, not on the driver migration.
# The historical WP001_ACT_COST_MEASURED=2 was the parent plus
# CORRECTION01. That is the TECHNICAL subset, correctly measured
# at the time, and it is preserved as such. It is NOT the full
# family cost.
# WHAT THIS DOES NOT JUSTIFY
# One noisy family is NOT a throughput rate. Multiplying 5 ACTs
# across the 20-package DAG would multiply a single
# governance-heavy sample. The DAG budget and critical path must be
# re-priced from the PACKAGE structure, with the governance
# overhead identified as a SEPARATE cost class, not folded into
# the per-package migration estimate.
# THE FIVE FAMILY COMMITS THAT CARRY NO ACT: TRAILER
#   3645738a5e075aee810d5adda6070cf843f63fbb  the parent C1
#   aa24305908fc8b80b07463bdebb81d8307dcf2ed  the parent C2

#   c0187d866272f4b57b7fd8aae0c04296edd2ef6e  CORRECTION01 C1
